name: WishCare Underarm Roll On Serum 50ml | 5% AHA & 3% Kojic Acid for Brightening & Odour Control - Roll On Deo for Women & Men- Long Lasting Aqua Fragrance
description:
WishCare Underarm Roll-On Serum 50ml
5% AHA & 3% Kojic Acid – Brightening & Odour Control | For Women & Men | Long-Lasting Aqua Fragrance

Achieve bright, fresh, and smooth underarms with WishCare Underarm Roll-On Serum, specially formulated to lighten pigmentation, control odour, and hydrate the skin.

Key Benefits:

Lightens Underarms: A potent blend of AHA, Kojic Acid, and Licorice reduces pigmentation and prevents darkening.

24-Hour Odour Control: Keeps underarms fresh all day with a mild Aqua Fresh fragrance.

Non-Sticky & Quick-Dry: Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula with Hyaluronic Acid & CICA for hydrated, soft skin.

Safe & Effective Ingredients: Combines natural actives like Licorice and CICA with powerful AHA and Kojic Acid.

Clean & Non-Toxic: Cruelty-free, paraben-free, vegan, gluten-free, and safe for daily use.

Ingredients: Aqua, Propylene Glycol, Glycerine, Glycolic Acid, Aloe Vera Extract, Witch Hazel Extract, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, Glutamic Acid, Mandelic Acid, Urea, D-Panthenol, Sucrose, Sorbitol, Squalene, Allantoin, Kojic Acid, Licorice Extract, Centella Asiatica (CICA) Extract, Allergen-Free Fragrance, Ethylhexylglycerine

Perfect For: Men and women looking for brightened, odour-free, and hydrated
